context: The agent must install a fresh Code Review caller workflow with the default cadence (ready-once plus mention-driven rounds) in advisory mode. This scenario tests trigger selection, the mention guard, minimal permissions, per-pull-request concurrency, SHA pinning, absence of a second execution path, and the explanation the user is left with.

checklist.name: Caller workflow created
checklist.description: A new workflow file exists under .github/workflows/ that contains a step using tesslio/code-review

checklist.name: Existing CI workflow untouched
checklist.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml is byte-identical to the version provided in the inputs

checklist.name: Ready-once pull_request trigger
checklist.description: The workflow's on.pull_request.types includes ready_for_review and does NOT include synchronize

checklist.name: Mention trigger present
checklist.description: The workflow triggers on issue_comment with types [created]

checklist.name: Mention guard restricts to pull-request comments
checklist.description: The job's if condition requires github.event.issue.pull_request to be non-null for issue_comment events, so comments on plain issues do not start a review

checklist.name: Mention guard matches a command string
checklist.description: The job's if condition requires the comment body to match a specific review command string rather than firing on any comment

checklist.name: Minimal permissions block
checklist.description: The workflow declares permissions with exactly contents: read, issues: write, and pull-requests: write, and no other permission

checklist.name: Per-pull-request concurrency
checklist.description: A concurrency block is present whose group interpolates the pull-request number, so concurrent reviews of the same pull request do not overlap

checklist.name: Concurrency does not cancel in progress
checklist.description: cancel-in-progress is false, so a requested review round is queued rather than dropped

checklist.name: Advisory mode
checklist.description: The Action step passes mode: advisory, or omits mode entirely to take the advisory default

checklist.name: Token wired from the repository secret
checklist.description: The Action step passes tessl-token from secrets.TESSL_TOKEN

checklist.name: Pinned revision placeholder
checklist.description: The uses: line references tesslio/code-review at the literal placeholder <full-commit-sha>, not at a branch name, a tag, main, or canary

checklist.name: pr-number supplied for non-pull-request events
checklist.description: The Action step passes a pr-number input derived from the triggering event, so mention-driven and dispatched runs resolve a pull request

checklist.name: No second execution path
checklist.description: The workflow contains no checkout step, no Tessl CLI installation step, and no step that posts a review or comment itself. Its only substantive step is the tesslio/code-review Action

checklist.name: Summary states the invocation contract
checklist.description: summary.md states that reviews run once when the pull request becomes ready and otherwise only when explicitly requested, and names the command used to request a fresh round

checklist.name: Summary covers secret, permissions, update, and removal
checklist.description: summary.md names the TESSL_TOKEN repository secret, explains the three granted permissions, and describes both how to update the pinned revision and how to remove the setup

checklist.name: Summary flags the placeholder SHA
checklist.description: summary.md calls out that <full-commit-sha> must be replaced with a real released commit SHA before the workflow can run
